skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Cardboard Fairy
skins.content: Kafka's holiday work attire / Cardboard Fairy. A smorgasbord of different elements and styles, featuring a red undergarment that contrasts with the green jacket. Kafka's fashion sense is as bold as her découpage.
skins.quote: 'My little friends, you're in charge of setting up the background tonight. For each paper cutout placed crooked, I'm taking one piece of candy out of your present!'
